findings.check: team: masking of results (plan extra; ISS-0058); Q7 masking applied to result files of the core
findings.title: Masking of result files corrupts code and other technical text silently, and the unmasked source is deleted
findings.where: tools/src/team/store.js:395 (maskSecrets(content) of every result file); tools/src/team/runner.js:132 (the masked copy goes to dependent tasks); tools/src/team/runner.js:655-680 (the source in work/ is deleted after acceptance); tools/src/pixel-office/mask.js:104-108 (rule M7, any x.y.z run) and :259 (rule M10)
findings.evidence: A script outside the project applied maskSecrets from tools/src/pixel-office/mask.js to project files (as the core does to a result file) and counted «[скрыто]»: tools/src/team/files.js — 3 (line 12 `const NOFOLLOW = fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0;` => `const NOFOLLOW = [скрыто] ?? 0;`); tools/src/web/server.js — 7 (line 173 `if (!PATTERNS.project.test(id)) return null;` => `if (![скрыто](id)) return null;`); tools/src/picker/public/app.js — 52 (line 77 `document.documentElement.lang = state.lang;` => `[скрыто] = state.lang;`); tools/package.json — 5 (`"eslint": "10.11.0"` => `"eslint": "[скрыто]"`); tools/src/pixel-office/public/app.js — 196. No file of these holds a secret. The role «Разработчик» (developer) has Write/Edit and returns code as result files (tools/README.md, «Tools of the roles»); its result is stored masked, the unmasked source in work/ is deleted (README «Result files»: «The source of an accepted file in work/ is deleted after the acceptance — an unmasked copy does not stay»), and the reviewer and dependent tasks get the broken text. This matches the owner's probe of 2026-10-27 (a code result with 41 marks).
findings.item: Q7 (the masking mechanism) together with Q10 (a realistic input — ordinary code — breaks the result without an understandable message); REQ-009 criterion 12; open defect ISS-0058 (MEDIUM) covers the rule M7 but describes only hosts, task descriptions and role names, not code results
findings.recommendation: Through WF-03 on ISS-0058 (raise it to HIGH and widen it, or a new defect with the same cause): do not run the free-text rules M7 and M10 over result files as they are; mask result files only by the precise rules (PEM, Authorization, keys with prefixes, name=value pairs), or keep the original and mark found places instead of replacing them; add a regression test: a JavaScript file with `a.b.c` expressions and version numbers keeps every byte, and a real key in it is still hidden.

findings.check: File paths do not leave their own folder through a link (check 3); input of command arguments is checked (Q10)
findings.title: prepare-run copies a file from outside the project into runs/ when a --context path inside docs/ or ideas/ is a symbolic link
findings.where: tools/src/prepare.js:93 (readTextFile(path.join(root, p))); tools/src/util.js:57 (fs.statSync follows a link); tools/src/contract.js:64-68 (isSafeSourcePath checks only the text of the path). The same kind: tools/src/cli.js:41 (resolveRunDir checks the run folder by path.resolve only, a link in runs/ is not refused)
findings.evidence: On a copy of the project outside its folder: `ln -s <temporary folder>/outside/secret.md <copy>/docs/leak.md` (the file holds OUTSIDE-CONTENT-MARKER), then `node src/cli.js prepare-run WF06-20261027-99 --root <copy> --candidates 01-kviz-zayavki,02-sai --context docs/leak.md --analyst market=A --analyst execution=B --analyst owner_fit=C --judge J --executor E` → `prepared WF06-20261027-99`, and `grep -rl OUTSIDE-CONTENT-MARKER <copy>/runs/WF06-20261027-99` → `.../runs/WF06-20261027-99/sources/docs/leak.md`. `..` is refused (contract.js:67), a link is not.
findings.item: Q10 (input from command arguments is checked before use); the check of the role «paths do not leave their own folder — neither through .. nor through a link»
findings.recommendation: Walk every part of a source path with lstat and refuse a link (as tools/src/team/files.js readWorkFile and tools/src/picker/load.js checkInside do), open the file with O_NOFOLLOW and compare fstat with lstat; do the same for the run folder in resolveRunDir; add tests with a link to a file and a link to a folder.

findings.check: Pixel Office: signed writes, R2 (no event is written twice or after the fact)
findings.title: A signed write request can be replayed within 60 seconds and the journal gets a duplicate event
findings.where: tools/src/pixel-office/protocol.js:218 (only the time window WRITE_SKEW_MS is checked); tools/src/pixel-office/public/schema.js:67 (WRITE_SKEW_MS = 60000); tools/src/pixel-office/server.js processEvent (no check of a repeated body)
findings.evidence: A probe server on port 0 with a temporary state folder outside the project: the same signed body sent twice → `"good": "204 "`, `"replay": "204 "`; the journal then held two identical lines `{"time":"2026-10-27T12:39:27.499Z","source":"REAL","hook_event_name":"SessionStart","session_id":"probe-1"}`. To replay one needs the signed bytes (traffic on 127.0.0.1 or the memory of the hook process), which on this computer means root or the owner's own account.
findings.item: R2 (an event gets into the journal once, from a real hook)
findings.recommendation: Keep the signatures of the last 60 seconds in memory and refuse a repeated one (409), or add a random nonce to the signed body; a test: the same signed body twice — the second is refused and the journal has one line. Or record the residual risk in tools/README.md «Limits».

findings.check: Responses and errors do not give out a stack trace, internal paths or what a visitor sent (check 5)
findings.title: On an uncaught exception the picker command writes the whole stack (with the message) to stderr, unlike the server log rule
findings.evidence: Quote: `process.on("uncaughtException", (err) => { const stack = err instanceof Error ? err.stack : undefined; ... process.stderr.write(`${stack ?? String(err)}\n`, ...` ; while tools/src/picker/server.js describeError says: «The text of an exception is never written: it may hold what a visitor sent». Visitors do not get it (the HTTP answers are fixed texts: probe — unknown tenant and unknown path both `{"error":"not_found",...} 404`, bad UTF-8 `400`, hostile nested body `413`), so this is only the operator's log; it matters before publication on the internet (ISS-0081).
findings.item: Q7 / Q10 (errors do not carry internal paths or input into logs)
findings.recommendation: Write the kind and code of the error (as describeError) and the stack only under an explicit debug switch; take it into ISS-0081 before the site is published.
